Hello to desk staff,
The training lead asked me to write about staff rotas

We need everyone to treat the Companion Animal Travel Desk rota as active and visible work, not a side task. When coverage is thin, passengers feel it at once, especially when they are worried about companion animal checks, handover details, or missing papers. Keep replies brief, accurate, and calm, and pass any uncertain case to the senior coordinator without delay. If you are moving between counters, update the handover notes before you leave so the next person does not waste valuable minutes chasing the same point.

<<FACT F094>> Please also remember that any transfer work must be logged cleanly, with the same care used for live bookings and arrival calls. If a case involves an incident report, follow the reporting path exactly as trained. <<FACT F102>> Do not improvise, skip steps, or assume someone else has already handled it. If you spot a gap in cover, a missed note, or a passenger whose travel file is incomplete, raise it at once and keep the tone respectful. Aurelia Skyways expects prompt communication, and this desk must show that standard every shift.

Use the rota to protect service quality, not just to fill hours. Be ready to swap support duties when pressure builds, and flag any personal conflict or absence early so the team can adjust without confusion. The work here is sensitive, and even small delays can affect the travel of animals and the confidence of their owners. Please read your assignment carefully, act on it immediately, and keep your updates clear and professional. Companion Animal Travel Desk,
